name.description: The thread's title. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

closed.description: Closes the thread when true and reopens it when false. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

locked.description: Locks the thread when true and unlocks it when false. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

visibleToRoles.description: Roles that may read this thread. Empty means everyone who may read the channel may read the thread.

visibleToMembers.description: Members that may read this thread beyond visibleToRoles.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks the thread.manage permission and is not the user who opened the thread renaming, closing or reopening it. Changing visibility or locking always needs thread.manage, and the user who opened a locked thread can't close or reopen it.

errors.name: ThreadNotFound
errors.description: No thread matches the given space reference.

errors.name: RoleHierarchy
errors.description: The requesting user cannot grant a role that outranks their own.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The arguments are inconsistent or malformed beyond schema validation.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.

main.description: Renames, closes, reopens or locks a thread, or changes who may read it. An absent field leaves the current value unchanged.
